evidence.evidence_text: Researchers have explored methods for automatically generating counterspeech to health misinformation as a mitigation strategy.
Existing approaches often produce uniform responses, ignoring that the health literacy level of the audience could affect the accessibility and effectiveness of counterspeech.
We propose a Controlled-Literacy framework using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with reinforcement learning (RL) to generate tailored counterspeech adapted to different health literacy levels.
